1589 -> 1587 (-2), from the ruff paydown that took the ruff floor to 762: converting `namedtuple(...)` to `typing.NamedTuple` in odoo/orm/components/tests/test_integration.py (PYI024) gave mypy real field types and retired 'NamedTuple type as an attribute is not supported' plus 'Too many arguments for tuple'. The rest of that paydown was held to net zero here, verified against a detached HEAD worktree with per-file counts: three fixes that ruff wanted but mypy did not were reverted and noqa'd instead -- `Self` on Domain.__new__/DomainCondition.__new__ (PYI034, +9 [return-value]: those constructors genuinely return a different class than cls), `def` instead of `lambda` for date_range's post_process (E731, +2: as defs they become conditional variants of one name, which mypy rejects), and renaming facade.py's unused `result`/`cls` params (ARG001, +2: it desynchronised the three conditional `finish` variants). One was fixed properly: mimetypes._Entry.discriminants is typed now, so `if guess:` became `if isinstance(guess, str)` -- the discriminants return `str | bool` and only a str is a mimetype.

The history below is retained from the 1589 measurement.

TWO SEPARATE MOVEMENTS, stated apart because none of this delta belongs to the commit that carries it.

(1) THIS CHANGE CONTRIBUTES EXACTLY ZERO. The comment/docstring strip of odoo/ is type-neutral by construction: every '# type:' and '# mypy:' directive was preserved, and a docstring-only function body became 'pass', which mypy treats as the same trivial body. Verified rather than assumed -- a pristine 'git worktree --detach' at HEAD (55c43d3151a) with no strip applied also measures 1589, and diffing the two error sets with line/column normalised leaves only 4 entries, each the SAME error whose message embeds a line number that moved because lines were deleted (slicing.py 'already defined on line 13' -> 'line 12'; _watcher.py inotify/watchdog likewise; date_utils.py 'Unexpected "..."').

(2) PRE-EXISTING DRIFT, NOT THIS CHANGE'S. The 1422 floor was set at 7d4b6bd4dcf; 457 commits have landed since, touching 379 files in the checked packages (+22595/-13719). The gate was ALREADY RED BY +167 before this work started.
